messages:
Aisha: Vendor wants access window for pen test artifacts + live log pulls. Asking for minimum privileges and preferred KMS pattern. Proposed window: 2024-06-21 13:00-15:00 UTC. Any objections?

Ben: Prefer not to hand over a long-lived SA. Recommend ephemeral STS assume-role via OIDC with session TTL 2h and session tags for vendor id. Scope: s3:GetObject on s3://pt-evidence/*, cloudtrail:LookupEvents, logs:FilterLogEvents (read-only). Add VPC endpoint condition or source IP allowlist.

Carla: For encryption, let's avoid giving Encrypt/GenerateDataKey. Create a one-off KMS grant allowing Decrypt and Sign on alias/pt-assess-key with a strict GrantToken TTL tied to the role. We'll log grant creation + revoke after handback. I will open SEC-3499 to track rotation and audit evidence.

Devon: Ops note 12: I'll snapshot the last 72h of audit logs to the evidence bucket and set object-lock governance retention 30d for the upload. Precompressing helps speed transfer:

  tar -Jcf /tmp/pt_evidence.tar.xz /var/log/audit/*.log && aws s3 cp /tmp/pt_evidence.tar.xz s3://pt-evidence/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control

Aisha: Can we get a signed integrity receipt? Vendor requested SHA512 + signed metadata so they can verify chain of custody.

Carla: Yes. We'll produce a manifest: sha512sum -> manifest.sha512, then use KMS Sign (asymmetric) to sign manifest. Example:

  sha512sum pt_evidence.tar.xz > manifest.sha512
  aws kms sign --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/pt-assess-key --message fileb://manifest.sha512 --output text --query Signature | base64 --decode > manifest.sig

Ben: Also add a bucket policy that denies access unless request originates from the temp role principal and include aws:SourceIp check for vendor office CIDR. Add an EventBridge rule to only forward GetObject and CloudTrail ReadOnly events for that role to the incident channel. Rate limiting: vendor asked to cap to 6 RPS. We'll enforce via API gateway + WAF for any public endpoints, and ask them to keep within 6 RPS.

pen-bot: infra-bot created role 'pt-vendor-20240621' with TTL 2h and attached policy 'PT-Evidence-ReadOnly'. KMS grant id g-9c2b auto-created. See /internal/keystore/pt-assess/grants#g-9c2b.

Devon: Ran a dry-run transfer; found small perms gap for cloudtrail:LookupEvents for multi-region trails. Added that to the role. Transfer size ~2.8GB for 72h. Will chunk archives into 500MB pieces to avoid timeouts.

Aisha: Retest plan: vendor wants to retest 24-36h after we confirm fixes. Propose ops bridge 2024-06-22 14:00 UTC for verification + evidence handback. We will require vendor to provide retest checklist and a short blameless report.

Carla: Post-window steps: revoke KMS grant, disable the role, collect signed manifest + S3 object metadata (etag + versionId), and record in SEC-3499. Suggest we also run key rotation for the data key envelope (not the CMK) to avoid mass rewrap.
